The '''University of Ruuria''' was a univeristy that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruuria/Legends|Ruuria]]. The [[Ruurian/Legends|Ruurian]] historian [[S. V. Skynx/Legends|S. V. Skynx]] was the emeritus chair of the [[Department of History]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] History subdepartment, pre-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] subdivision of the University of Ruuria.
